# UKDA - Quiet clarity

A premium private project workspace, as thoughtful and calm as an Apple productivity app. Customer-facing language only. Spacious but useful, precise typography, thin lucide-style icons, restrained green actions, a small multicolour geometric triangular bar brand mark. No gradients, glass, glossy cards, tech dashboards, giant marketing headings, fake charts or decorative clutter. Light: off-white #F7F8F7 canvas, white surfaces, ink #202722, muted #69726E, subtle #E5E9E6 outlines, primary forest #176B50. Dark: #111613 canvas, #19201B surfaces, ink #ECF1ED, muted #9AA89D, outline #303A32, primary #9CD7B9 with dark ink. 12px cards, 8px controls, 44px touch targets. Inter with tabular numbers. Desktop 224px sidebar, 64px topbar, content max1280 with32px margins; mobile collapses sidebar and keeps clear Back actions. States accessible AA with strong focus and reduced-motion support. 160–220ms fades and tiny translate; never impede work.

Navigation: Overview, Projects, My tasks, Inbox, People; Settings at bottom plus theme/profile menu. Customer workflows: licence activation, Owner recovery words, password confirmation, name and illustrated avatar choice; invited people join through private invitation; remembered profile name plus one password input; forgot-password recovery or ask an Owner; device approval; projects with phases called Waves, collaborative tasks with multiple assignees, milestones, blockers, reviews, discussion, progress; project archive/reopen; people/roles/invites/equal Owners; preferences/timezone/password/devices/recovery/export/deletion. Explain decisions plainly. Never show backend terms, IDs, API, keys/epochs/generations/ciphertext/OPAQUE/WASM/receipts/migrations. Invitation codes and recovery words are user-facing necessities, explain safely and briefly. Every form has Cancel/Back, validation, clear success and next action. Loading, empty, offline/retry, access-denied and unavailable destinations have useful recovery actions. No email login or photo uploads. Twenty illustrated geometric creature avatars with twelve independent colours. Add a discrete disabled Future features section under Settings: Email updates, Integrations, Customer-hosted processing, each greyed out with 'Not available in this build.' These have no fake action or broken link.

A supplied local animated brand mark is used ONCE at startup, not a fabricated spinner; reuse its static multicolour bars in sidebar and entry pages. Generate actual product screens, not a marketing landing page. Use realistic but clearly design-only example content. UI must be translatable to semantic HTML and keyboard navigation.
